functions.name: finance_supply_amount
functions.source:
SELECT finance_supply_money(v->'supply') AND finance_supply_money(v->'tax') AND finance_supply_money(v->'total')
   AND (v->>'supply')::numeric+(v->>'tax')::numeric=(v->>'total')::numeric

functions.name: finance_supply_assert_agreement
finance_supply_assessment_valid
finance_supply_draft_valid
functions.source:
DECLARE x jsonb; c jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF finance_supply_keys(v,ARRAY['schemaVersion','subjectId','title','reason','lines','members','allocations','claims']) IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR v->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'de0-supply-review-v1' OR finance_supply_id(v->'subjectId') IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR finance_supply_text(v->'title',1,200) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_text(v->'reason',1,2000) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR length(btrim(v->>'title'))=0 OR length(btrim(v->>'reason'))=0
  OR jsonb_typeof(v->'lines') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v->'lines') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  OR jsonb_typeof(v->'members') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v->'members') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  OR jsonb_typeof(v->'allocations') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v->'allocations')>400
  OR jsonb_typeof(v->'claims') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v->'claims')>200 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 FOR x IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'lines') LOOP
  IF finance_supply_keys(x,ARRAY['lineId','description','dateFrom','dateTo','fulfillment','documentId','evidenceLocation','supply','tax','total']) IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR finance_supply_id(x->'lineId') IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_text(x->'description',1,1000) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR length(btrim(x->>'description'))=0
   OR vat_followup_date(x->>'dateFrom') IS DISTINCT FROM true OR vat_followup_date(x->>'dateTo') IS DISTINCT FROM true OR x->>'dateFrom'>x->>'dateTo'
   OR (x->>'fulfillment') NOT IN('completed','partial','advance','unknown') OR x->>'fulfillment' IS NULL
   OR (x->'documentId'<>'null'::jsonb AND finance_supply_id(x->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM true)
   OR finance_supply_text(x->'evidenceLocation',0,500) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_amount(x) IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR x IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'members') LOOP
  c:=x->'correction';
  IF finance_supply_keys(x,ARRAY['memberId','kind','sourceId','correction']) IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR finance_supply_id(x->'memberId') IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_id(x->'sourceId') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR x->>'kind' NOT IN('card','hometax','tax_invoice') OR x->>'kind' IS NULL
   OR finance_supply_keys(c,ARRAY['isCorrection','reason','originalApprovalNumber','originalMemberId','referenceStatus','role','documentId','evidenceLocation']) IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR jsonb_typeof(c->'isCorrection') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean' OR finance_supply_text(c->'reason',0,2000) IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (c->'originalApprovalNumber'<>'null'::jsonb AND finance_supply_id(c->'originalApprovalNumber') IS DISTINCT FROM true)
   OR (c->'originalMemberId'<>'null'::jsonb AND finance_supply_id(c->'originalMemberId') IS DISTINCT FROM true)
   OR c->>'referenceStatus' NOT IN('not_collected','not_provided','unresolved','declared') OR c->>'referenceStatus' IS NULL
   OR c->>'role' NOT IN('unknown','reversal','replacement','delta') OR c->>'role' IS NULL
   OR (c->'documentId'<>'null'::jsonb AND finance_supply_id(c->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM true)
   OR finance_supply_text(c->'evidenceLocation',0,500) IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (c->'originalMemberId'<>'null'::jsonb AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'members') m WHERE m->>'memberId'=c->>'originalMemberId')) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR x IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'allocations') LOOP
  IF finance_supply_keys(x,ARRAY['allocationId','memberId','lineId','supply','tax','total']) IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR finance_supply_id(x->'allocationId') IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_id(x->'memberId') IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_id(x->'lineId') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR finance_supply_amount(x) IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'members') m WHERE m->>'memberId'=x->>'memberId')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'lines') l WHERE l->>'lineId'=x->>'lineId') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR x IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'claims') LOOP
  c:=x->'cReference';
  IF finance_supply_keys(x,ARRAY['claimId','lineId','memberId','origin','reference','claimedSupply','claimedTax','coverage','documentId','evidenceLocation','cReference']) IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR finance_supply_id(x->'claimId') IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_id(x->'lineId') IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_id(x->'memberId') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR x->>'origin' NOT IN('external','c_consumption') OR x->>'origin' IS NULL
   OR finance_supply_text(x->'reference',0,1000) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_money(x->'claimedSupply',false) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_money(x->'claimedTax',false) IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR x->>'coverage' NOT IN('exact','partial','unknown') OR x->>'coverage' IS NULL
   OR (x->'documentId'<>'null'::jsonb AND finance_supply_id(x->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM true)
   OR finance_supply_text(x->'evidenceLocation',0,500) IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (x->>'origin'='external' AND c<>'null'::jsonb)
   OR (c<>'null'::jsonb AND (finance_supply_keys(c,ARRAY['revisionId','pairLineNo']) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_id(c->'revisionId') IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_money(c->'pairLineNo',false) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR (c->>'pairLineNo')::numeric>99))
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'members') m WHERE m->>'memberId'=x->>'memberId')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'lines') l WHERE l->>'lineId'=x->>'lineId') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'lines') item GROUP BY item->>'lineId' HAVING count(*)>1)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'members') item GROUP BY item->>'memberId' HAVING count(*)>1)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'allocations') item GROUP BY item->>'allocationId' HAVING count(*)>1)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'claims') item GROUP BY item->>'claimId' HAVING count(*)>1) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN true;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN false;
END

functions.name: finance_supply_immutable
functions.source: BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DE-0 review history is immutable: %',TG_TABLE_NAME USING ERRCODE='23514'; END

functions.name: finance_supply_keys
functions.source:
SELECT jsonb_typeof(v)='object' AND
   (SELECT array_agg(k ORDER BY k COLLATE "C") FROM jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v)='object' THEN v ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) k)
   IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT array_agg(k ORDER BY k COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(expected) k)

constraints.name: finance_supply_review_revisions_basis_json_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((finance_supply_keys(basis_json, ARRAY['schemaVersion'::text, 'subjectId'::text, 'subjectSnapshotText'::text, 'subjectSnapshotHash'::text, 'subjectIssues'::text, 'sources'::text, 'documents'::text, 'cReferences'::text]) AND (basis_json ->> 'schemaVersion'::text) = 'de0-supply-basis-v1'::text AND finance_supply_id(basis_json -> 'subjectId'::text) AND jsonb_typeof(basis_json -> 'subjectSnapshotText'::text) = 'string'::text AND (basis_json ->> 'subjectSnapshotHash'::text) ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND jsonb_typeof(basis_json -> 'subjectIssues'::text) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_typeof(basis_json -> 'sources'::text) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_typeof(basis_json -> 'documents'::text) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_typeof(basis_json -> 'cReferences'::text) = 'array'::text) IS TRUE)

constraints.name: finance_supply_review_revisions_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (preview_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND preview_hash = vat_followup_hash_v2(jsonb_build_object('draft', payload_json, 'basis', basis_json, 'assessment', assessment_json)))

constraints.name: finance_supply_review_revisions_check5
constraints.definition: CHECK (state = 'recorded'::text AND withdrawal_reason IS NULL OR state = 'withdrawn'::text AND withdrawal_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(withdrawal_reason)) >= 1 AND length(btrim(withdrawal_reason)) <= 2000)
